Extremely Disappointing Stay — Not Worth the Price!

Our experience at this property was highly disappointing. The service was extremely slow and poor — we had to request three times just to get our dinner plates cleared, yet no one attended to it.

There was too much movement and disturbance at night. As two females staying alone, we were terrified when someone rang our doorbell at 12:30 AM. We did not open the door and felt very unsafe.

The rooms are quite small, and the hotel is overpriced for a 3-star property. At the same rate, you can easily find a much better 4-star hotel with superior service and facilities.

Getting hot water was a constant struggle — you need to call the reception every time you want it, as it comes from a central boiler. We had to call five times in the morning before receiving hot water. Even for drinking water, we had to ask four times before it was finally sent to the room.

To make matters worse, the staff incorrectly accused us of consuming a Kit Kat from the fridge, which was never there in the first place. Clearly, their inventory management is poor, and guests are made to justify themselves for staff errors.

After we checked out and cleared all bills, we were contacted again after three hours and asked to settle payment that had already been made. We had to share Paytm screenshots as proof, which was a complete waste of time and energy.

The front desk staff, especially the man in charge, was extremely rude and full of attitude. People working in hospitality should be courteous and polite, but that basic professionalism was completely missing.
Overall, this was a horrible experience — poor service, unprofessional staff, safety concerns, and zero value for money. Would never recommend or stay here again.
